program.name: Boxing Express
program.subject: Boxing
program.blurb: Short boxing sessions: straight bouts, or footwork bouts and a short EMOM.
program.about: Boxing in a short slot. One day is a run of bouts, punches, power and defence; the other is footwork bouts, then a short EMOM of punches and push-ups. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Both later levels bring longer combinations and harder moves.
program.split: Short bouts / footwork bouts & EMOM, short
